learning_outcomes.text: They know terms and methods of product development and can apply them.
They can classify, evaluate, and use different development methods.
They can abstract a practical problem according to functional aspects.
They can select, apply, and evaluate suitable methods of product development.
They possess the ability for results-oriented teamwork.

syllabus_topics: Model ideas for the product development process
teaching_methods: Weekly team meetings with industry representatives during active project work phase (Nov. - Feb.)

assessment_methods.method: Project work (processing a task in cooperation with an industrial company in a team of 4 students)

bibliography: Grote, Karl-Heinrich u. a. (Hg.): Dubbel – Taschenbuch für den Maschinenbau, Springer Vieweg: Berlin 2018.
Pahl, Gerhard u. a. (Hg.): Konstruktionslehre. Methoden und Anwendung erfolgreicher Produktentwicklung, Springer Vieweg: Berlin/Heidelberg (8. vollst. überarbeit. Auflage) 2013.
